object_description: autonomous building volume organized around peripheral passageways
design_condition: The volume maintains the existing landscaped continuity while anticipating a future north-south axis and denser network of buildings.

positive.statement: The project forcefully develops a flexible and scalable architecture from the specificities of academic space.

position.rationale: Dense central mass and continuous peripheral bands support a building-scale flexibility judgment.

positive.statement: Peripheral circulation and informal meeting spaces support exchange, stimulation, and collective learning.

position.target: peripheral circulation and informal meeting spaces
position.rationale: Top view clearly shows circulation bands surrounding the dense central area.

positive.statement: The project anticipates future territorial development while remaining effective as an autonomous object.

position.target: future territorial development and autonomous object
position.rationale: Distributed envelope and concentrated center indicate an autonomous object with territorial expansion capacity.

negative.statement: The proximity of research spaces and practical-work spaces is questionable.

position.rationale: Interior program adjacency is not distinguishable; placement estimates a central working zone.

negative.statement: The transparency and visibility of the laboratories must be clarified and modulated according to use and operation.

position.rationale: Laboratories are not identifiable; estimate uses a south-west peripheral zone.

negative.statement: The delivery-access principle, technical premises, and storage provision require clarification or improvement.

position.target: delivery access, technical premises, and storage
position.rationale: Operational spaces are absent; approximate low-level east-south perimeter access.

negative.statement: The mechanized glass skin is undesirable in terms of operation, maintenance, and safety.

position.rationale: The critique concerns the building envelope, anchored to the visible east facade.

negative.statement: Light penetration toward study and research areas raises questions despite well-lit and naturally ventilated passageways.

position.target: light penetration toward study and research areas
position.rationale: Interior daylight performance is unresolved; estimate places affected areas beside peripheral passageways.

negative.statement: The spans are too large, and the high cost of the passageways calls for optimization.

position.rationale: Broad structural criticism is anchored across the passageway network and central volume.
